text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 56 और 57 पर ‘The Olympic Champion’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 56 aur 57 par ‘The Olympic Champion’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘The Olympic Champion’ on pages 56 and 57 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What do we know about the ancient Olympic Games?

questionMeaning.hi: हम पुराने ओलंपिक खेलों के बारे में क्या जानते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Hum puraane Olympic khelon ke baare mein kya jaante hain?

options: They were held in Greece in 776 B.C. at Olympia.
They were held in India in 1928.
steps.answer: They were held in Greece in 776 B.C. at Olympia.
steps.modelAnswer: We know only a few things about the ancient Olympic Games. An Olympic sports festival was held in Greece in 776 B.C. at Olympia.

modelMeaning.hi: हम पुराने ओलंपिक के बारे में थोड़ा ही जानते हैं। 776 ईसा पूर्व में ग्रीस के ओलंपिया में एक खेल उत्सव हुआ था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Hum puraane Olympic ke baare mein thoda hi jaante hain. 776 isa poorv mein Greece ke Olympia mein ek khel utsav hua tha.

steps.question: Where did the Olympic Games get their name from?

questionMeaning.hi: ओलंपिक खेलों का नाम कहाँ से आया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Olympic khelon ka naam kahan se aaya?

options: from Olympia, the place in Greece where they were held
steps.answer: from Olympia, the place in Greece where they were held
steps.modelAnswer: The Olympic Games got their name from Olympia, the place in Greece where they were first held.

modelMeaning.hi: ओलंपिक का नाम ग्रीस की जगह ओलंपिया से आया, जहाँ ये पहली बार हुए।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Olympic ka naam Greece ki jagah Olympia se aaya, jahan yeh pehli baar hue.

steps.question: Who won a gold medal for rowing in the Olympic Games of 1928?

questionMeaning.hi: 1928 के ओलंपिक में नाव-दौड़ का स्वर्ण पदक किसने जीता?
questionMeaning.hinglish: 1928 ke Olympic mein naav-daud ka swarn padak kisne jeeta?

steps.modelAnswer: Bobby Pearce won a gold medal for rowing in the Olympic Games of 1928.

modelMeaning.hi: बॉबी पियर्स ने 1928 के ओलंपिक में नाव-दौड़ का स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bobby Pearce ne 1928 ke Olympic mein naav-daud ka swarn padak jeeta.

steps.question: At what age did he win the first race?

questionMeaning.hi: उसने पहली रेस किस उम्र में जीती?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Usne pehli race kis umar mein jeeti?

steps.modelAnswer: He won his first race at the age of six, against fourteen-year-olds.

modelMeaning.hi: उसने छह साल की उम्र में पहली रेस जीती, चौदह साल के लड़कों के ख़िलाफ़।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Usne chhah saal ki umar mein pehli race jeeti, chaudah saal ke ladkon ke khilaaf.

steps.question: Who did he compete with in the finals of the Amsterdam Olympics?

questionMeaning.hi: एम्स्टर्डम ओलंपिक के फ़ाइनल में उसका मुक़ाबला किससे था?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Amsterdam Olympic ke final mein uska mukaabla kisse tha?

steps.modelAnswer: He competed against Ken Myers of America in the finals.

modelMeaning.hi: फ़ाइनल में उसका मुक़ाबला अमेरिका के केन मायर्स से था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Final mein uska mukaabla America ke Ken Myers se tha.

steps.question: What caused Bobby to slow down in the middle of the race?

questionMeaning.hi: रेस के बीच में बॉबी ने रफ़्तार क्यों कम की?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Race ke beech mein Bobby ne raftaar kyon kam ki?

options: A duck and her ducklings were swimming across his path.
steps.answer: A duck and her ducklings were swimming across his path.
steps.modelAnswer: Bobby slowed down because a duck and her ducklings were swimming across the waterway into the path of his boat.

modelMeaning.hi: बॉबी ने रफ़्तार कम की क्योंकि एक बत्तख और उसके बच्चे उसकी नाव के रास्ते में तैर रहे थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bobby ne raftaar kam ki kyonki ek battakh aur uske bachche uski naav ke raaste mein tair rahe the.

steps.question: What did he do when he saw a duck and her ducklings swimming across the waterway?

questionMeaning.hi: बत्तख और उसके बच्चों को देखकर उसने क्या किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Battakh aur uske bachchon ko dekhkar usne kya kiya?

options: He slowed down and waited till they were out of danger.
He stopped the race and went home.
steps.answer: He slowed down and waited till they were out of danger.
steps.modelAnswer: He slowed down his boat and waited until all the ducklings were out of danger. Then he picked up speed and won the race.

modelMeaning.hi: उसने नाव धीमी की और बच्चों के सुरक्षित निकलने तक रुका। फिर तेज़ होकर रेस जीत गया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Usne naav dheemi ki aur bachchon ke surakshit nikalne tak ruka. Phir tez hokar race jeet gaya.

text.en: Now the book's true or false.

steps.question: True or false? Athletes come from all the countries to take part in the Olympic Games.

questionMeaning.hi: ओलंपिक में सब देशों के खिलाड़ी आते हैं।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Olympic mein sab deshon ke khilaadi aate hain.

steps.question: True or false? Bobby Pearce's father was a great wrestler.

questionMeaning.hi: बॉबी के पिता बड़े पहलवान थे।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bobby ke pita bade pahalwaan the.

steps.modelAnswer: False. His father was a great sculling (rowing) champion.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। उसके पिता नाव-दौड़ के चैंपियन थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Uske pita naav-daud ke champion the.

steps.question: True or false? At the age of six, Bobby won the first race.

questionMeaning.hi: छह साल की उम्र में बॉबी ने पहली रेस जीती।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Chhah saal ki umar mein Bobby ne pehli race jeeti.

steps.question: True or false? The people on the bank were silent.
steps.modelAnswer: False. They were cheering and shouting.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। वे चिल्ला रहे थे और हौसला बढ़ा रहे थे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Woh chilla rahe the aur hausla badha rahe the.

steps.question: True or false? His friends in the Australian Olympic team were not surprised.
True or false? In all these years he lost a few races.

questionMeaning.hi: इन सालों में वह कुछ रेस हारा।
questionMeaning.hinglish: In saalon mein woh kuch race haara.

steps.modelAnswer: False. He never lost a single race.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। वह एक भी रेस नहीं हारा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Woh ek bhi race nahi haara.
